turns.text: That is our firewood pile. I cover it with a tarp every night, but it sits right against the wall.
The brush is what I cut last weekend. I have not hauled it away yet, it is still green.
This fence is old cedar. It was here when we bought the place.

findings.instruction: Move the pile over 30 feet from the house or keep it fully covered with fire-resistant material at all times.
findings.reason: Homeowner said the pile sits against the wall and is only covered with a tarp at night.

findings.instruction: Replace the old cedar fence near the house with fire-resistant material.
findings.reason: Homeowner said the fence is old cedar that was already there when they bought the place.

findings.instruction: Haul away the cut brush pile now, even though it is still green, to clear within 30 feet.
findings.reason: Homeowner said the cut brush pile is still there because it has not been hauled away yet.
